Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Neha Tripathi,Vinay Kumar Tripathi
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Re: Modification Application
1. Heard Sri Mukesh Kumar Kushwaha, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2.

This writ petition has been filed seeking quashing of the first information report dated 01.10.2022 in Case Crime no. 489 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 307, 377, 354 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Civil Lines, District Aligarh with further prayer not to arrest the petitioners pursuant Ashu @ Ashu Mailk And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172724494/
1 to the said FIR.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed mention slip with an endorsement and photocopy of the WhatsApp message sent to learned counsel for the informant with an endorsement that the same has been duly received.
4. Vide order dated 15.2.2023, the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre and the petitioners were directed to deposit a sum of Rs.50,000/- before the Mediation Centre

out of which, Rs.
25,000/- was to be paid to the wife on her appearance on the first date and the balance Rs. 25,000/-
was to be paid to her on completion of the mediation proceedings if the same is successful.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that demand draft dated 21.2.2023 was deposited before the Mediation Centre, however, the wife never appeared before the Mediation Centre and consequently, the mediation has failed.

6. We have gone through the report from the Mediation Centre dated 03.6.2023 according to which,
only petitioner no.1 appeared on 12.5.2023 and, therefore, parties are not willing for mediation

7. Submission is that the petition came to be finally dismissed on 23.8.2024, however, the sum of Rs. 50,000/- as deposited vide bank draft dated 21.2.2023 is still lying with the Mediation Centre which is liable to be returned to petitioner no.1 as the wife never appeared before the Mediation Centre.
8. We find substance in the argument of learned counsel for the petitioners.

9. Accordingly, this modification application stands allowed and the Mediation Centre is directed to refund the sum of Rs. 50,000/- deposited before the Mediation Centre vide bank draft dated 21.2.2023 to petitioner no.1.

Order Date :- 4.10.2024 Madhurima  Ashu @ Ashu Mailk And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172724494/
